title: Chain rule along C¹ charts for any admissible tangential differential
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, f locally Lipschitz on U, and L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) such that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, t ↦ f(x + tv) has derivative L(x)v at 0 for every v in every weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x. Let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be C¹ and antilipschitz on an open Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ. Then for Lⁿ-a.e. w ∈ Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(M): DΦ(w)(ℝⁿ) is the weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at Φ(w), and f∘Φ has Fréchet derivative L(Φ(w))∘DΦ(w) at w.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M)), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ (Φ w) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap) ∧ HasFDerivAt (f ∘ Φ) ((L (Φ w)).comp (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) w
